const patch = "*** Begin Patch
*** Add File: /app/output/gen.py
+#!/usr/bin/env python3
+"""Live, observation-guided controller for the RoboCasa GR1 plate-to-pan episode.
+
+The process keeps one RCB client connected.  Commands are JSON lines on stdin:
+
+  {"op":"obs"}
+  {"op":"move", "right":[x,y,z,rx,ry,rz], "left":[...],
+   "hand_right":[6 values], "hand_left":[6 values], "steps":80}
+
+Coordinates are robot-base-frame absolute targets.  Observations and action
+metadata are saved under /app/runs/live for review.
+"""
+import json
+import os
+import sys
+import time
+
+import numpy as np
+
+sys.path.insert(0, "/opt/tools")
+from rcb_client import Robot
+
+OUT = "/app/runs/live"
+os.makedirs(OUT, exist_ok=True)
+robot = Robot()
+spec = robot.spec()
+dt = float(spec["control_dt"])
+steps_per_chunk = int(10.0 / dt)
+obs_index = 0
+
+LAYOUT = spec["proprio_layout"]
+IDX = {n: i for i, n in enumerate(LAYOUT)}
+
+
+def current_command(meta):
+    p = np.asarray(meta["proprio"]["now"], dtype=float)
+    names = ["cmd_right_x", "cmd_right_y", "cmd_right_z", "cmd_right_rx",
+             "cmd_right_ry", "cmd_right_rz", "cmd_left_x", "cmd_left_y",
+             "cmd_left_z", "cmd_left_rx", "cmd_left_ry", "cmd_left_rz",
+             "cmd_right_little", "cmd_right_ring", "cmd_right_middle",
+             "cmd_right_index", "cmd_right_thumb_flexion", "cmd_right_thumb_rotation",
+             "cmd_left_little", "cmd_left_ring", "cmd_left_middle", "cmd_left_index",
+             "cmd_left_thumb_flexion", "cmd_left_thumb_rotation"]
+    return p[[IDX[n] for n in names]]
+
+
+def observe(cameras=None, depth=True):
+    global obs_index
+    if cameras is None:
+        cameras = ["robot0_agentview_center", "egoview",
+                   "robot0_eye_in_right_hand", "robot0_eye_in_left_hand"]
+    res = robot.get_obs(cameras=cameras, include_depth=depth, video="none")
+    obs_index += 1
+    path = os.path.join(OUT, f"obs_{obs_index:03d}")
+    res.save(path)
+    return {"saved": path, "meta": res.meta, "cameras": list(res.meta.get("cameras", {}).keys())}
+
+
+def move(cmd):
+    prev = current_command(cmd["meta"])
+    goal = prev.copy()
+    for side, pose_range, hand_range in (("right", slice(0, 6), slice(12, 18)),
+                                          ("left", slice(6, 12), slice(18, 24))):
+        if side in req:
+            v = np.asarray(req[side], dtype=float)
+            if v.shape != (6,):
+                raise ValueError(f"{side} pose must contain 6 numbers")
+            goal[pose_range] = v
+        hkey = f"hand_{side}"
+        if hkey in req:
+            v = np.asarray(req[hkey], dtype=float)
+            if v.shape != (6,):
+                raise ValueError(f"{hkey} must contain 6 numbers")
+            goal[hand_range] = v
+    n = int(req.get("steps", 80))
+    if n < 1 or n > steps_per_chunk:
+        raise ValueError(f"steps must be in 1..{steps_per_chunk}")
+    actions = np.linspace(prev, goal, n + 1, dtype=np.float64)[1:]
+    cams = req.get("cameras", ["robot0_agentview_center", "egoview"])
+    res = robot.submit("ee_pose", actions, dt=dt, interpolate="hold",
+                       cameras=cams, video="none", note=req.get("note", ""))
+    path = os.path.join(OUT, f"action_{res.meta.get('calls', 0):03d}")
+    res.save(path)
+    return {"saved": path, "meta": res.meta}
+
+
+print(json.dumps({"ready": True, "protocol": spec.get("protocol"),
+                  "control_dt": dt, "max_chunk_steps": steps_per_chunk,
+                  "spec_cameras": list(spec["cameras"]),
+                  "time_left_s": spec.get("budget", {}).get("wall_clock_s")}), flush=True)
+last = None
+for line in sys.stdin:
+    try:
+        req = json.loads(line)
+        op = req.get("op")
+        if op == "obs":
+            ans = observe(req.get("cameras"), req.get("depth", True))
+        elif op == "move":
+            if last is None:
+                last = robot.get_obs(cameras=["robot0_agentview_center"], video="none")
+            ans = move(last)
+            last = robot.get_obs(cameras=["robot0_agentview_center"], video="none")
+            ans["post_meta"] = last.meta
+        elif op == "status":
+            ans = robot.status()
+        elif op == "quit":
+            print(json.dumps({"ok": True, "quit": True}), flush=True)
+            break
+        else:
+            raise ValueError("op must be obs, move, status, or quit")
+        print(json.dumps(ans, default=lambda x: x.tolist() if hasattr(x, "tolist") else str(x)), flush=True)
+    except Exception as e:
+        print(json.dumps({"error": type(e).__name__, "message": str(e)}), flush=True)
*** End Patch";
const result = await tools.apply_patch(patch);
text(result);
